title: 11. Projects: Agentic RAG
objectives: Build the Agentic RAG projects end to end
Keep a short README with assumptions and tradeoffs

sections.title: Project Structure
sections.body:
```
agentic_rag/
│
├── .env
├── documents.py          ← Multi-domain knowledge bases
├── embeddings.py         ← Azure OpenAI embeddings
├── vector_store.py       ← Vector store per knowledge domain
├── indexer.py            ← Build domain-specific indexes
│
├── patterns/
│   ├── 01_routing_rag.py         ← Route to right KB
│   ├── 02_query_rewriting_rag.py ← Rewrite bad queries
│   ├── 03_iterative_rag.py       ← Retrieve until satisfied
│   ├── 04_corrective_rag.py      ← CRAG — fix bad retrievals
│   ├── 05_self_rag.py            ← Decide IF to retrieve
│   ├── 06_fusion_rag.py          ← Multi-query fusion
│   ├── 07_multihop_rag.py        ← Chain retrievals
│   └── 08_adaptive_rag.py        ← Choose strategy dynamically
│
└── main.py               ← Run all patterns
```
